brief:
Five Palestinians, including a woman and a child, were killed Monday by Israeli gunfire and strikes across Gaza, IMEMC News reported. Civil Defense crews separately recovered the body of another Palestinian who had been killed in an earlier attack.

The deaths mark the latest casualties in the besieged territory, where ongoing Israeli military operations have devastated civilian infrastructure and caused widespread casualties since the conflict's escalation.
dek: Five Palestinians, including a woman and a child, were killed on Monday by Israeli gunfire and strikes across the devastated and besieged Gaza Strip, while Civil Defense crews recovered the body of another Palestinian killed in an earlier attack.
title: Israeli attacks kill five Palestinians across Gaza
